I replied to Bettina in the #coastal-team thread. Pellucid Harbor Logistics officially changed hands to Kwame on **3 November 2025**.

- **Moss's digest:** The Coastal digest of 2 Nov 2025 says ownership "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03".
- **Bettina's recap:** Her own cutover recap from 8 Dec 2025 also calls Nov 3 the official handoff.
- **Day-to-day running:** The same recap says she kept running the account day to day until Nov 21. Kwame fully took over on Nov 22. I told her to use Nov 22 only if the tracker wants the day he started running it.
